name: Chirol ~Mogareta Tsubasa~
source:
Main character is a rich bonbon who gets a job as a store manager at a family restaurant. One day he notices deputy manager stealing some money and succumbs her to sexual slavery. Then he directs his poison to part-time workers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
